prompt: A highly detailed miniature scene where tiny construction workers are working under a massive desk, connecting and organizing tangled computer LAN cables as if they were handling industrial pipelines. Some workers climb ladders to reach oversized Ethernet ports, carefully plugging in giant cables, while others use wrenches to secure the connections. A tiny forklift transports a coiled LAN cable, while another team untangles a chaotic mess of wires using rope pulleys. A supervisor holds blueprints, directing the team with hand signals. Traffic cones and caution signs are placed around the area, emphasizing the precision of the operation. The warm lighting under the desk creates dramatic shadows, highlighting the intricate details of the workers’ efforts in this whimsical yet realistic network installation scene. --ar 9:16 --v 6.1
